messages:
Sarah L (PM): Quick Q from the all-hands — when you say 'refocus on latency-first product teams', what does that mean for open IC hiring and our backend team headcount? Are we moving folks internally or making new reqs? Timeline?
Maria G (CEO): Short answer: both. We're prioritizing infra & runtime work; plan is to net +6 backend/runtime engineers in Q2, funded by slowing some growth/product feature hiring (-4) and reprioritizing contractors. We'll also enable internal transfers first. Details below.
Jen P (VP People): We'll run a role-mapping window next week. If managers expect transfers, please submit internal mobility intents by `2024-05-10`. Link: https://intra.redwood.com/reorg-transfer-form :sparkles:
Kevin T (CTO): For clarity — hiring concentrates on: 1) serving runtime (layer-2 kernels, batching), 2) model ops for deployment rollouts, 3) infra automation for Dedicated. GPU infra SREs get top priority.
Aj R (Recruiting): We're opening 8 reqs this month: 5 backend/runtime eng, 2 infra SRE, 1 staff SWE for model ops. Expect (ETA) first interviews by `2024-05-20`. Managers, please review JD templates in #devex.
Luke M (Eng Manager): How are we protecting teams that lose headcount temporarily? On-call already stretched.
Maria G (CEO): Good point. We'll provision a 6-week overlap buffer + increase short-term contractor budget to cover support. Ops leads, coordinate with Jen and Kevin.
Jen P (VP People): We'll provide relocation/training stipends for transfers, and a transitional hire freeze waiver process for critical teams. Docs: https://intra.redwood.com/reorg-guides
Sarah L (PM): thanks — will share with my team. any change to hiring bar or interview loop?
Kevin T (CTO): Interview loops unchanged. Hiring bar remains the same; we may add a short runtime-focused take-home for backend roles.
Aj R (Recruiting): Noted. I'll update the req templates and ping managers in #eng-hiring. :thumbsup:
Maria G (CEO): Appreciate the questions. We'll follow up with a public gist of the headcount delta and team-by-team plan by EOW.
reorg-bot: [Reminder] Internal mobility window opens 2024-05-01 and closes 2024-05-10.
Luke M (Eng Manager): heads up — I'll flag two ICs interested in transfer. thanks.
